label: Actual copying and complete record provenance yield exact target recovery
meaning: A nonmental sufficient process bundle with the same causal coverage and transport standard. CopiesTarget constrains actual production relative to an independently given target; it is not assumed record soundness. The theorem derives exact-value record truth, while access to a genuine historical target and the mechanism's applicability remain OPEN. The explicit no-plan/no-attitude witness tests functional parity, not a complete impersonal worldview.
